999008199.text: 久しぶりに戻ってきたよ、オーベンランド

localizations.en: Back again, at long last. Obenland.

999008199.text: 話には聞いていたけど、静かで寂しい雰囲気の場所だね

localizations.en: I'd heard about this place, but it really is quiet. Almost lonesome.

999008199.text:
そうだね、世界の果てと言われても
納得できるような所さ

localizations.en: It is. Even calling it the edge of the world doesn't feel like an exaggeration.

999008199.text:
この先に広がる、暗く、寂しく、荒涼とした氷の海――
そこには強力な魔物がたくさんいる

localizations.en: Beyond this point lies the Midnight Sea—dark, desolate, frozen solid. And full of powerful monsters.

999008199.text:
暗黒の氷海、でしょ。
大丈夫、覚悟は決めてきたよ

localizations.en: The Midnight Sea. Yeah, I know. Don't worry—I made up my mind before we set out.

999008199.text:
この先は、「九偉人図」の情報を基に進むんだよね。
前回はなかったけれど、今回はこの手掛かりがある

localizations.en: From here on, we're navigating by the Portraits of the Nine, right? We didn't have it last time, but now we do.

999008199.text:
ああ。「九偉人図」には、果ての大陸への道筋が
星の位置や方角で示されている。危険が少ない道筋がね

localizations.en: Right. The Portraits of the Nine use star positions and bearings to mark a path to World's End—the safest route there is.

999008199.text:
危険がまったくないわけじゃないが、私たちは今確かに
これまでで最も果ての大陸へ近づいている……！

localizations.en: It's not without danger, but we're closer to World's End right now than we've ever been before...!

999008199.text:
兄さんの夢が叶いそうで、私も嬉しいよ。
王国の未来的にもね！

localizations.en: I'm so happy for you, seeing your dream this close. Good for the kingdom, too!

999008199.text: クレオ……兄想いのよくできた妹よ……

localizations.en: Creo... what a wonderful, devoted little sister you are...

999008199.text:
小さい頃はね、兄さんのこと私が守って
面倒見てあげなきゃって思ってたんだ

localizations.en: When we were little, I always felt like I had to be the one looking after you.

999008199.text:
あっちにふらふら、こっちにふらふらしてたからね。
あ、それは今も同じか！

localizations.en: You were always drifting off this way and that. Though... I guess that hasn't changed much!

999008199.text: 甲斐性なしで悪かったね……

まあでも、今の兄さんならきっと私は必要ない。
そう思ったんだ

localizations.en: But the way you are now? I think you'll be just fine without me.

999008199.text:
クレオ……そんなことはない、
兄さんには妹が必要だとも

localizations.en: Creo... that's not true. Your brother needs his little sister.

999008199.text: いや、ブラッドさんがいるから
さっきから上げては落としてくるね！

localizations.en: You built me up just to knock me right back down!

999008199.text:
ゴホン！　にしても……多分この光景、
オルペウス兄上も見たかったと思うんだ

localizations.en: Ahem! Anyway... I think Orpheus would have wanted to see this too.

999008199.text: そうなの？

理由は違うけどね。私は冒険、兄上は実利。
果ての大陸に眠るマナがあれば国民は豊かになる

localizations.en: For different reasons, though. I'm here for the adventure—he'd be thinking about the practical gains. All that dormant mana could mean real prosperity for our people.

999008199.text:
オルペウス兄さん……長男だから、きっと色々
我慢して、頑張ってくれてるんだよね

localizations.en: Orpheus... he's the eldest, so I'm sure he's had to give up a lot and just keep pushing through.

999008199.text:
そうだね、私やクレオのわがままを許して、
ランターナもしっかりまとめてくれてる

localizations.en: He has. He puts up with our selfishness and keeps Lantarna together. Both of us.

999008199.text:
すごい人だよ。さっきのクレオじゃないけど、
私も兄上を支えてあげたい。不甲斐ない弟だけどね

localizations.en: He's remarkable, really. Like you said—I want to be there for him too. Even if I'm a bit of a hopeless younger brother.

999008199.text:
私も！　よくできた妹としてオルペウス兄さんの
力になってあげるんだ！

localizations.en: Me too! As his very capable little sister, I'm going to be a real asset to Orpheus!

999008199.text:
ほう、兄弟のいる国家は跡目争いで揉めがちだが、
ランターナは兄弟仲も良好のようだな

localizations.en: Hmm. Nations with multiple royal heirs tend to fall apart over succession squabbles. Lantarna seems to be the exception.

999008199.text:
もしかして、向こうの会話が聞こえるんですか？
耳聡いですね

localizations.en: Could you hear them from all the way over here? Your ears are sharp.

999008199.text:
私だってこの距離くらいならなんとか……！
ユリウス探しで鍛えた目と耳で！

localizations.en: I can just barely manage from this distance too...! Years of hunting for Julius have honed my eyes and ears!

999008199.text: お母さんは張り合わないで、ね？

localizations.en: Please don't compete with him, Mom.

999008199.text:
絶対的な王が君臨する国は繁栄する。
ランターナ王国は安泰かもしれんな

localizations.en: A nation with a capable ruler at its head tends to flourish. Lantarna may be in good hands after all.

999008199.text:
うん、私たちの国は大丈夫だなって思う。
王族がこんなに近くて、優しいなんて！

localizations.en: Yeah, I really do think our kingdom will be alright. Royalty this warm and down-to-earth—you don't see that often!

999008199.text:
私も色々よくしてもらってるし……
今回の旅で受けた恩、少しでも返せるといいな

localizations.en: They've done so much for me too... I really hope I can repay even a little of that kindness on this journey.
